costs.scope: Own validation/copy/index/search/proof/return preparation; caller serialization excluded. Cooperative, no OS quota.

tree.scope: Exact finite anchored binary proof-tree adaptation, integer capacity 2 and root seed 1. Complete structural MP/GEN/zero identities are checked; the declared catalogue and non-axiom zero logical truth additionally need current independent catalogue/schema assurance. All positive native proofs need unchanged C1 and independent B, and original-theory lowering when lemmas are imported. No infinite tiling, fixed translation palette, unrestricted FOL negative or equality of tree/DAG/primitive bounds.
